# Story and Smiles Photography

> Candid wedding photographer based in Banashankari, Bengaluru, serving couples and families across South India. 6+ years of experience, 5.0★ from 92 Google reviews.

Story and Smiles Photography is a wedding, pre-wedding, maternity, newborn and event photography studio led by founder Karthik. Full-day wedding coverage starts at ₹45,000. Edited galleries are delivered within 3–4 weeks.

## Primary

- [Homepage & Booking](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/): Full service list, pricing, portfolio, testimonials, FAQ, and contact form.

## Services

- [Wedding Photography](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-wedding): Candid, traditional and cinematic coverage. Full-day from ₹45,000; half-day from ₹25,000.
- [Pre-Wedding Shoot](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-pre-wedding): Couple sessions at scenic Bangalore locations. From ₹15,000.
- [Maternity & Baby Shower](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-maternity): Studio or at-home sessions. From ₹12,000.
- [Newborn Photography](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-newborn): Baby-led, safety-first in-home sessions. From ₹10,000.
- [Event Photography](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-event): Corporate events, birthdays, anniversaries, house warmings, naming ceremonies.
- [Portfolio Photography](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#svc-portfolio): Professional portfolios for models, actors and professionals.
- [All Services](https://story-and-smiles-photography.vercel.app/#all-services): Complete list including videography, drone, album design, photo restoration and product photography.
